newsitems.title: My Steam account is now forever tainted with an achievement I got for accidentally upskirting a katana-wielding machine girl
newsitems.author: Mollie Taylor
newsitems.contents: Even after a couple of hours with Full Metal Schoolgirl, I'm not entirely sure what it wants to be: a shooter, a roguelite, a campy yet lewd robo-corpo hack-and-slash? It's a little bit of everything, and doesn't particularly excel in any aspect. Yet I'm weirdly endeared to its bizarre late 2000s jankiness... Read more.
